title: eat shit & die 175
author: bpatrick
html: The way Jonny Paycheck likes Onan warms my heart. Here’s another. As always loads of fun to draw but it took me a week to color. I had meant for it to be a mid-week extra last week but it didn’t work out. Maybe one of these days I’ll play with coloring the inks a little. It turned out OK, I just wish it looked more like Dresden Codak.

comments.author: Erick
comments.html: I think it looks sweet. I am not a proffessional.

comments.author: Winston Rowntree
comments.html: Well, we humans are unfortunately never gonna be as good at coloring as dresden codak, but you’ve done a great job here i reckon. Really like the faded-out-background effect in panel 2, plus the Huge Purple Thing is pretty striking.
